critique.evidence: Desktop, tablet, and mobile scans report no confirmed WCAG violations, no viewport overflow, and no touch-target violations. However, color contrast remains seriously incomplete for 20 screen nodes at every viewport because the gradient background prevented measurement. No keyboard-navigation or reduced-motion test evidence was provided, so demo readiness is not established.
critique.fix: Measure contrast against the rendered gradient and correct every failing text/state to WCAG AA. Add Playwright evidence for complete keyboard operation, logical focus order, visible focus, no traps, and activation of the uncertain-case control; also verify prefers-reduced-motion disables or reduces all nonessential animation.
